changeSet.comment:
Remove the four cards absent from the physical printed deck. Tampering starts at rank 3; Elevation of Privilege starts at rank 5.
OPERATOR NOTE: This changeset deletes reference-data rows that are protected by RESTRICT foreign keys from hand_card and trick_play (see 004-trick-play-schema.xml). It will HALT if any active or historical game session still references these cards. Before running this migration on a database that has ever hosted a dealt game, either: (a) delete all game sessions (and their cascading hand_card / trick_play rows), or (b) run the rollback of any in-flight sessions first. On a fresh database (e.g. CI, a new deployment) this precondition is always satisfied.
